content:
My favorite Apple TV 4K feature — the screensavers — could finally get sound in tvOS 27, based on the latest leak. Here's the details.

tvOS 27 code reveals that at least one Apple TV screensaver will gain a sound option, with more likely to come

October is expected to be a big month for Apple, with a long list of new hardware and software products coming.

Among the rumored products is a new Apple TV 4K, which previously leaked in Apple code with its images.

On the software side, leaker pdfu just dropped evidence from the tvOS 27 code revealing that at least one Apple TV screensaver is gaining sound support.

As you can see from the video above, the Snoopy screensaver has a hidden option to toggle sound on or off, or use a "Reduce" setting.

Snoopy is a relatively non-distracting example of a screensaver, but I'm glad Apple plans to let users fully turn off the sound if they want.

Although pdfu hasn't found sound support in other screensavers yet, it's very likely Apple will expand this feature to more screensavers in the future.

What do you think about tvOS 27 potentially adding sound options to Apple TV screensavers? Drop your thoughts in the comments.
